name: GoPublish: Publish from Google Docs to Any Site
author: GoPublish Team

sections.description:
Looking for a way to export content from Google Docs™ to any website?
GoPublish.io provides a streamlined solution. No formatting issues, no copy-pasting, and no unnecessary manual work.

Customer Reviews

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Rated 4.8 stars on Google Workspace Marketplace and on G2.

Free Forever

Start publishing today with our free plan (includes 10 exports per month).

Watch GoPublish in Action:

Key Features:

✅ One-click publishing – Export Google Docs™ to any website as drafts, private, scheduled, or published posts.
✅ Clean formatting – Headings, bold text, lists, links, and images are transferred exactly as they appear in Docs.
✅ SEO-friendly – Add meta titles, descriptions, alt text, excerpts and slugs right from Google Docs™.
✅ Plugin integrations – Works with Yoast, SEOPress, Squirrly, AIOSEO, RankMath to maintain keyword-optimised meta data.
✅ Bulk publishing – Use Google Sheets to publish multiple Docs to any website at once.
✅ Two-way sync – Update website posts from Google Docs and vice versa — stay perfectly in sync.
✅ Granular team access – Control who can publish on which site across your team.
✅ AI-powered metadata – Auto-generate SEO meta data with smart AI suggestions.
✅ Image SEO – One-click image compression and AI-generated alt text, right inside Google Docs™.
✅ Post type flexibility – Export content as posts, pages, or custom post types for any website platform.
✅ Dynamic content updates – Edit in Docs and push live changes to your website.
✅ Built for everyone – Ideal for content teams, agencies, and solo bloggers who want speed without losing control.
✅ Free Forever plan – Get started free, no credit card required.

SEO Plugin Compatibility

GoPublish auto-detects and integrates with:
Yoast SEO, RankMath, AIOSEO, SEOPress, Squirrly SEO

Data Handling:

This plugin does not transfer any data to GoPublish or any third parties. It simply creates a new REST API endpoint on your WordPress site to indicate whether the plugin is active, which can be checked by the GoPublish services API.
For more information, please refer to:
– GoPublish Website
– Terms of Service
– Privacy Policy
sections.faq:
Is GoPublish free to use?

Yes — we’ve a Free Forever plan. Premium plans are also available for power users.

Do I need the Google Workspace add-on?

Yes — it’s required for content transfer and SEO data preservation.

Can I use GoPublish without an SEO plugin?

Yes, but SEO meta preservation won’t be available.

Is it secure?

Yes — uses WordPress’s REST API with authentication.

Does it work with page builders?

Yes — GoPublish publishes at the post, page and custom post level, compatible with common page builders.
